AboutHero.mainTitle: A Global Quranic Academy Teaching Allah's Book as Revealed
AboutHero.leadText: Nour Academy was established as a trusted educational beacon connecting Muslims worldwide to the Holy Quran, with authentic Sanad and modern pedagogy.
AboutHero.storyParagraph: We launched to serve Muslim families and expatriate youth, providing a secure environment that blends Al-Azhar certified scholars licensed in the ten Qira'at with flexible digital sessions. Our mission extends beyond memorization to instilling genuine love and contemplation of the Quran.

AboutVisionValues.sectionTitle: Our Foundations in Teaching Allah's Book
AboutVisionValues.sectionDesc: Combining authentic Al-Azhar Sanad with modern pedagogy to nurture a Quran-connected generation.
AboutVisionValues.visionDesc: To be the premier, trusted global destination for learning the Holy Quran, Tajweed, and related sciences, making authentic Sanad accessible worldwide.
AboutVisionValues.missionTitle: Conveying the Quran with Utmost Mastery
AboutVisionValues.missionDesc: Providing personalized, interactive sessions led by certified Al-Azhar scholars, instilling love for the Quran and Arabic language.

AboutMethodology.sectionTitle: Rigorous Standards Ensuring Premium Quranic Education
AboutMethodology.sectionDesc: A disciplined pedagogical process from strict scholar onboarding to continuous personalized progress tracking.
AboutMethodology.step1Desc: Beyond authentic Sanad licenses, tutors undergo comprehensive testing in practical Tajweed, articulation accuracy, and modern child pedagogy.
AboutMethodology.step2Desc: Initial skill assessment followed by a tailored memorization plan accommodating the student's age, routine, and weekly capacity for steady progress.
AboutMethodology.step3Desc: Monthly performance reports documenting new memorization, retention review, and Tajweed milestones with transparent updates sent directly to parents.

AboutGallery.sectionDesc: Highlights from our Quran graduation ceremonies, authentic Sanad conferrals, and annual student competitions.

AboutCTA.desc: Book your free trial class now, meet your certified Al-Azhar tutor, and assess your current level effortlessly.
AboutCTA.perk3: No credit card or commitment required
